# Relient Solutions

> Relient Solutions is an engineering, software, and AI transformation company headquartered in Hyderabad, India. We build high-performance custom web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, distributed enterprise software, AI process automations, and autonomous telephony voice agents, including our proprietary flagship product Donna AI.

## Company
- [About Relient](https://relient.solutions/about): Company background, problem-first engineering approach, core competencies, and verified technical credentials.
- [Contact](https://relient.solutions/contact): Direct consultation booking, WhatsApp direct line (+91 83098 04884), and inquiry channels.

## Flagship Product
- [Donna AI Voice Agent](https://relient.solutions/products/donna-ai): Autonomous enterprise telephony AI voice agent developed by Relient Solutions. Handles inbound/outbound phone calls 24/7, qualifies leads, schedules appointments in Google Calendar/CRMs, and delivers structured post-call summaries with sub-second response latency.

## Engineering Services
- [Services Directory](https://relient.solutions/services): Overview of engineering tiers and fixed-milestone pricing models.
- [Web Development](https://relient.solutions/services/web-development): Fast, modern web applications, client portals, and marketing platforms (React, Next.js, Edge CDN).
- [Mobile App Development](https://relient.solutions/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android cross-platform apps with offline-first synchronization and push notifications.
- [Custom Software](https://relient.solutions/services/custom-software): Tailored business systems, operational back-office platforms, and bespoke relational database schemas.
- [Enterprise Software](https://relient.solutions/services/enterprise-software): High-throughput distributed ERPs, multi-warehouse inventory ledgers, and automated GST billing engines.
- [AI Development](https://relient.solutions/services/ai-development): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), private document parsing, and custom domain LLM integrations.
- [AI Automation](https://relient.solutions/services/ai-automation): End-to-end workflow orchestration connecting forms, CRMs, WhatsApp, and database pipelines.
- [Voice AI](https://relient.solutions/services/voice-ai): Telephony voice AI integration, SIP trunking, and Donna AI custom deployments.

## Target Industries
- [Industries Hub](https://relient.solutions/industries): Overview of tailored industry solutions.
- [Healthcare & Clinics](https://relient.solutions/industries/healthcare): 24/7 patient appointment scheduling, Donna AI clinic receptionist, and lab PDF delivery.
- [Restaurants & Hospitality](https://relient.solutions/industries/restaurants): Phone reservation handling, direct online ordering, and ingredient inventory tracking.
- [Retail & E-Commerce](https://relient.solutions/industries/retail): Sub-second POS checkout billing, multi-godown stock sync, and GST e-invoicing.
- [Manufacturing](https://relient.solutions/industries/manufacturing): Raw material replenishment triggers, bills of materials (BOM), and batch defect traceability.
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://relient.solutions/industries/logistics): After-hours freight intake via Donna AI, driver mobile apps, and digital proof-of-delivery.
- [Education & Academies](https://relient.solutions/industries/education): Student admissions lead qualification, parent communication portals, and automated fee reminders.
- [Real Estate](https://relient.solutions/industries/real-estate): Inbound buyer qualification, site visit booking, and automated WhatsApp property brochures.
